title: Campus Customs MCP server: smoke test of all 26 tools through the Claude Code connector
run_at: 2026-11-03 14:59 (real time); the shop's own date is 2026-08-31
database: data/campus_customs_new.db (the working copy; data/campus_customs.db is never opened)
how: Each entry is one tool call made from inside the Claude Code session: the prompt that led to it, the tool, its arguments, and the output exactly as returned. The 15 read tools ran first on the untouched seed, then the 11 write tools in dependency order (the invoice must be paid before Bulldog Print Co accepts an order), then the changed tables were read again. db_check holds the SQL run afterwards against the working copy by output/check_mcp_smoke.py, the value expected from the output, the value the database gave, and whether they match. For reads taken before the writes, the SQL checks the columns the writes did not touch, or reconstructs the earlier value (for example the balance before payments).
